svg.text: Who calls PRISM, what runs inside one API process, and what it reads off disk.
Ingest, Matching and Export share one filesystem by contract: IngestResult carries an absolute
NormalizedJpgPath, not bytes. A Matching host that cannot read the job temp folder fails loud.
Only the four public services may be moved out of process; media enters PRISM through in-process ingress only.
